messages.author: bcb52a2d8001a6d1
messages.subject: Identifying points marked as outliers
parts:
GGplot2ers,

I would like to identify the data points that are marked as outliers on a ggplot2 boxplot.  I have tried
mean(X, na.rm=T) + 2.5*IQR(X, na.rm=T)
for the upper limit.  But this does not catch any outliers when outliers are, in fact, plotted.
Can someone please help me?

Troy

messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Re: Identifying points marked as outliers
parts:
There's this thread regarding labeling outliers with different color:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/168a8ef571fec1fc/eb3fbb2b75fbe811?lnk=gst&q=outliers#eb3fbb2b75fbe811

Seems like using  geom_text in addition to boxplot would be ideal, with some rule for only plotting points in geom_text that are outliers. 

S
